provenance.section_title: Critical Question 1: Patient Disposition with Clinical Decision Aids - Recommendations and Overview

rules.rationale: Clinical decision aids like PSI and CURB-65 can support clinical judgement by identifying patients at low risk of mortality who may be appropriate for outpatient treatment.
rules.citation: The Pneumonia Severity Index [SNOMED: 406529000] (PSI) and CURB-65 decision aids can support clinical judgement [SNOMED: 61254005] by identifying patients [SNOMED: 372039005] at low risk of mortality [SNOMED: 409651001] who may be appropriate for outpatient [SNOMED: 373864002] treatment.

rules.rationale: Use the 2007 IDSA/ATS Minor Criteria rather than mortality prediction aids such as the PSI or CURB-65 to help establish which patients are most appropriate for care based in an ICU setting among patients not receiving vasopressors or mechanical ventilation.
rules.citation: Among patients not receiving vasopressors [SNOMED: 870406003] or mechanical ventilation [SNOMED: 40617009], use the 2007 IDSA/ATS Minor Criteria rather than mortality [SNOMED: 409651001] prediction aids such as the PSI or CURB-65 to help establish which patients are most appropriate for care based in an ICU [SNOMED: 309904001] setting

rules.rationale: Early identification and appropriate disposition of patients with CAP who will need ICU care is important because those with delayed ICU transfer have higher mortality than patients admitted directly to the ICU.
rules.citation: Early identification of patients with CAP who will need ICU [SNOMED: 309904001] care is important because those with delayed ICU [SNOMED: 309904001] transfer [SNOMED: 129347002] from the hospital floor [SNOMED: 709280007] to the ICU [SNOMED: 309904001], such as for respiratory failure [SNOMED: 409622000] or septic shock [SNOMED: 76571007], have higher mortality [SNOMED: 409651001] than patients who were admitted [SNOMED: 32485007] directly to the ICU [SNOMED: 309904001].
